speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given you are pregnant and experiencing vaginal bleeding with abdominal pain, have you noticed any leakage of fluid or regular contractions? When did these symptoms first begin, and has your uterus felt firm or tender?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the timing of contractions stopping after bleeding onset is significant given your prior C-section. Have you experienced any gush of fluid, or do you notice the baby moving normally? REQUEST TEST: Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring. REQUEST IMAGES: Transabdominal Ultrasound.
